mapper.insert: insert into user_bill (user_id, ledger_id, category_id, amount, type, bill_type ,create_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{ledgerId},#{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{type},#{billType}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select user_bill.*,category.name as categoryName ,user.username as belongName from user_bill left join category on user_bill.category_id = category.id left join user on user_bill.user_id = user.id where user_bill.id = #{billId} and user_bill.ledger_id = #{ledgerId}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cost FROM user_bill WHERE ledger_id = #{ledgerId} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ASC;

UPDATE user_bill
category_id = #{userBill.categoryId},
amount = #{userBill.amount},
type = #{userBill.type},
remark = #{userBill.remark},

user_id = #{userBill.userId},
bill_type = #{userBill.billType}
WHERE id = #{userBill.id} and user_bill.ledger_id = #{ledgerId}
mapper.select: select user_id, sum(case when type = 1 then amount else 0 end) as totalIncome, sum(case when type = 2 then amount else 0 end) as totalExpend, sum(case when type = 1 then amount when type = 2 then -amount else 0 end ) as totalBalance from user_bill where ledger_id = #{ledgerId} and bill_type = 'multiple' group by user_id;

select participant_id as userId, sum(case when type = 1 then share_amount else 0 end) as totalIncome, sum(case when type = 2 then share_amount else 0 end) as totalExpend, sum(case when type = 1 then share_amount when type = 2 then -share_amount else 0 end ) as totalBalance from bill_participant p left join user_bill ub on ub.id = p.bill_id where ledger_id = #{ledgerId} group by p.participant_id
